name: Mega Blue

features.text: Protects and restores nonporous surfaces on vehicle exteriors.
High silicone content for exceptional gloss on tires and trim. PERFORMANCE RATING - Gloss - 9 • Durability - 8

description: A fast-drying, solvent-based dressing that creates an ultra-high gloss and protective barrier on rubber, vinyl and plastic surfaces such as exterior trim, tires, and molding.
application: Exterior Trim: 1.) Spray product on sponge applicator pad. 2.) Apply product to vinyl, plastic and rubber surfaces with pad. 3.) Allow to dry, or wipe dry with clean towel. Tires: 1.) Prior to applying product, tire surface should be clean, dry a free of any debris. 2.) Either spray product on sponge applicator pad and wipe on tire or using a trigger sprayer, apply a fine mist to the surface. 3.) Allow product to thoroughly dry and wipe off excess product before moving vehicle. Important: Improper application of solvent-based dressing on tires may result in "sling" of excess product, which can stain adjacent painted surfaces. Always wipe excess product from tires.
